In Public Sector & Government, quantum & advanced compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Citizen records and diplomatic traffic face HNDL exposure at scale; crypto inventory is unknown.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: Accessibility (Section 508 / EN 301 549 / WCAG) and GDPR / national privacy law. Citizen data duties including automated-decision transparency. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
